build_bedrock_agentcore_config: build a BedrockAgentCoreA2AConfig instance for A2A-native agents that forwards JSON-RPC requests directly
run_handle_non_streaming: run handle_non_streaming on BedrockAgentCoreA2AConfig to send a non-streaming request to an AgentCore A2A agent
run_handle_streaming: run handle_streaming on BedrockAgentCoreA2AConfig to send a streaming request to an AgentCore A2A agent
test_BedrockAgentCoreA2AConfig: test the BedrockAgentCoreA2AConfig class validates that litellm_params with an AgentCore ARN are required
review_handle_non_streaming: review the handle_non_streaming method of BedrockAgentCoreA2AConfig that delegates to BedrockAgentCoreA2AHandler
